newsitem.title: GERMANY: Work starts on TNT parts centre for Smart.
newsitem.headline: Work starts on TNT parts centre for Smart.

text.p: Work has started on a 20.5 million marks European parts distribution centre in France's Lorraine region for the new "Smart" compact two-seater car, TNT Logistik GmbH said.
TNT Logistik, the logistics arm of global integrator TNT, said it will operate the centre in Hambach, Lorraine, eastern France, under a European distribution contract.
The "Smart" car is a small city car being developed by Micro Compact Car AG (MCC), a joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie (SMH) .
Smart car production in the "Parc industriel Smart-ville" in Hambach would start in autumn 1997 with the sales launch in 1998, TNT said.
The 18,600 square metres MCC parts distribution centre within the industrial park was due to open at the end of 1997, it added.
More than 100 Smart car centres in Europe would be served from Hambach with daily requirements estimated at 12,000 items, TNT said.
